law_card.title: ⚖️ Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961
lines: Sec 3: Giving OR taking dowry → at least 5 years jail + fine of at least ₹15,000 (or the dowry's value)
Sec 4: Even asking for it → 6 months to 2 years
law_card.note: For awareness only. Not legal advice.

youtube.description:
बेटी की शादी में पापा ने 'गिफ़्ट' में कार दी… पर LLB पढ़ रही मीरा ने सबके सामने सच बोल दिया! 😱
A father gives a car as a 'gift' at his daughter's wedding, but the bride, a law student, calls it what it is: dowry.

⚖️ Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961
• Section 3: giving OR taking dowry is a crime: at least 5 years in jail and a fine of at least ₹15,000 or the value of the dowry, whichever is more.
• Section 4: even demanding dowry, directly or indirectly, is punishable with 6 months to 2 years.
• Real wedding presents are allowed only when nothing was demanded, they are customary, not excessive for the giver's means, and entered in a list of presents (Section 3(2)).

For awareness only, not legal advice. Fictional story.
